test_title: PYST 41: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 25 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All dress are cloth.

All shirts are cloth.

All ties are cloth.

Conclusions:

(I): Some ties are dress.

(II): Some shirts are tie.
solution:

Conclusions:**
(I): Some ties are dress.- False (As their is no direct relation between ties and dress may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

(II): Some shirts are tie.- False (As their is no direct relation between ties and shirtsmay be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

**Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"**
